candidates: MemorySize property for ThumbnailerFunction in the IaC template
answer.explanation: ThumbnailerFunction is configured at 128 MB while its peers run at 256 MB (Crud, Uploader) or 1024 MB (Compression). Its Max Memory Used is about 103-105 MB, roughly 82% of the allocation, so it has almost no headroom. Lambda allocates CPU in proportion to memory, which fits steady-state durations of about 380-400 ms against roughly 100 ms for the 256 MB Uploader on similar work. Cold starts are frequent, with many INIT_START events and Init Durations of 430-550 ms, and billed durations are inflated, for example 2587 ms billed for a 2154 ms duration. Some invocations reach about 2.2 s. This points to the function being under-provisioned at the configuration level. The template and concurrency candidates are inferred from the pattern; the truncated logs do not show the template or the timeout value directly.
